title: Cohorted release staircase + OKR synchronization for quarterly hosted API & model catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and operationalize a cohorted 'release staircase' for quarterly hosted API + model catalog updates. Goal: coordinate model swaps and endpoint change windows across customer cohorts to reduce blast radius, align deliverables to OKRs, and provide deterministic capacity/backstop plans. This ticket scopes the playbook, success metrics, gating criteria, and runbook for a repeatable cadence that PMs, Eng, Design, and CS can adopt for the quarter.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized cohort definitions (alpha, beta, general) and onboarding checklist for each cohort
Gating criteria documented: latency P95 target, error rate ceiling, regression delta on quality eval set, cost-per-1M token delta
Canary windows and rollback triggers specified with corresponding automation hooks (feature flags / rollout scheduler)
Operational runbook for capacity hedges and fallback routing validated with staging stress test
Stakeholder signoff (Eng lead, SRE, Security, CS) and one dry-run scheduled before production rollout
success_metrics: 0% customer-visible regressions above quality regression threshold during canary (measured on eval suite)
Latency P95 remains within 1.2x of baseline for 95% of requests during cohort rollout
Rollbacks performed automatically < 30 minutes when triggers exceeded
End-to-end deployment time across cohorts reduced by 20% compared to previous quarter
Clear OKR linkage: contributes to OKR-HostedAPI-Q2-2 (reduce production incidents) and OKR-Models-Q2-1 (increase model rollout velocity)
tasks: PM: finalize cohort segmentation and communication plan (Aisha)
Eng: implement rollout scheduler hooks + feature flag integration (Marcel)
SRE: design capacity hedge scenarios and automated fallback policies
Design/Docs: produce one-page cohort readiness checklist and customer-facing note template
CS/Support: prep monitoring playbook and escalation path for cohort alpha
Research: assemble evaluation prompt set for regression detection tied to customer cohorts
